# hippius-mem

> An MCP server that gives coding agents a shared team memory. Notes are encrypted on the machine and stored in a Hippius S3 bucket. Every change is a signed operation.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

The docs site does not have a hippius-mem guide. The installer for an agent is FOR-AGENTS.md in this repository. The human guide is the README.

## What it is and what it does

A local MCP server. Teammates share one encrypted log in a bucket they own. The binary is Apache-2.0. The bucket is ordinary Hippius S3 and is billed as S3.

There is a local solo trial that does not need a bucket. A team install needs a bucket.

## How to install

Follow https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-mem/blob/main/FOR-AGENTS.md

Short form, when the human already has a team:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-mem/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
hippius-mem install --all-detected
cd <their project> && hippius-mem init
hippius-mem doctor
```

Solo trial, no bucket: `sh scripts/install.sh --solo` from a clone. Do not run that inside this source checkout. FOR-AGENTS.md says why.

## Credentials

A team install asks for the team namespace, the bucket, the shared team key, and an S3 access key plus secret. Those values stay out of the git repo and out of chat. The config file is `~/.config/hippius-mem/hippius-mem.toml`.

S3 keys come from the console: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/s3
What S3 is: https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-s3/blob/staging/llms.txt
